chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Ahmad ibn Idris narrated to us. He said: My father narrated to us from al-Husayn ibn Ubaydullah, from Muhammad ibn Abdullah, from Muhammad ibn al-Fudayl, from Abu Hamza. He said: I heard Abu Ja'far al-Baqir (peace be upon him) saying:

Allah, Mighty and Majestic, revealed to Muhammad (may Allah bless him and his family): O Muhammad! Indeed I created you when you were nothing, and I breathed into you of My Spirit as an honour from Me that I bestowed upon you, so that I obliged all My creatures to obey you. Whoever obeys you has indeed obeyed Me, and whoever disobeys you has indeed disobeyed Me. And I have obliged the same regarding Ali and those of his progeny whom I have designated for Myself.

key_terms.أوحى: Divine revelation (wahy), the highest form of communication from God
key_terms.اختصصت: Designated/chosen exclusively, divine selection for a special role
key_terms.الطاعة: Obedience, religious obligation to follow divine authority
key_terms.روحي: My Spirit - a divine bestowal of honor, not literal composition

ai.seo_question: What did God reveal to Prophet Muhammad about obedience to Ali and the Imams?
ai.summary: This hadith qudsi (divine saying) conveys God's direct revelation to Prophet Muhammad (SAWW), affirming the divine origin of his creation and the breath of God's Spirit into him. It establishes that obedience to the Prophet equals obedience to God, and extends this same obligation to Ali and the designated Imams from his lineage. Imam al-Baqir narrated this in the scholarly circles of early 2nd-century Medina, where establishing the theological basis for Imamate was central to Shia doctrine.

en.bilal-muhammad: Al-Husayn b. Ahmad b. Idris narrated to us. He said: My father narrated to us from al-Husayn b. `Ubaydullah from Muhammad b. `Abdullah from Muhammad b. al-Fudayl from Abi Hamza. He said: I heard Aba Ja`far al-Baqir (as) say:

Allah revealed to Muhammad (s): O Muhammad! I created you when you were nothing, and I breathed into you of My Spirit as an honour that I have bestowed over you. I have obliged all My creatures to obey you, so whoever obeys you has obeyed Me, and whoever disobeys you has disobeyed Me. I have also obliged that for `Ali and those of his progeny who I have designated for Myself.
